pages.text: $(bold)Silent Glove$()$(br2)Obtaining: craft it at the $(bold)Tinker Station$() — combining a Silent Glove Core + Silent Glove Surface parts.$(br2)Features:$(li)when $(bold)bare-handed$(), automatically draws a weapon from the $(bold)Spatial Singularity Vault$()$(li)worn on the hand, it expands your $(bold)ring curio slots$() (Curios)$(li)right-click with it in your main hand to open the Spatial Singularity Vault interface

$(bold)Spatial Singularity Vault$(): a portable weapon vault that can hold several weapons; the Silent Glove lets you switch to a weapon automatically whenever you are bare-handed, saving you from constantly opening your inventory.$(br2)The Vault's capacity and the extra slots it grants increase with its level.
